fullPassage: During the Ice Age, not only was the planet much colder, with ice sheets covering much of what we call the northern hemisphere today, but, crucially, it was much drier. In Ireland, we often associate the cold with the wet but if it is really cold, there is far less evaporation, fewer clouds, and less rain. Our world in the Ice Age was cold and dry, meaning it was difficult for plants to grow. In this type of climate, farming isn't an option: it's too risky to depend on any one piece of land to produce the energy you need. As the temperature rose and the ice caps melted, we experienced a sudden explosion of life. The world got warmer and wetter, and people started to live around places where they could make food grow most intensively. This didn't happen overnight; it probably took thousands of years, with hunter-gatherers foraging and hunting, while doing a little side hustle in farming.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② more dry → drier: dry는 1음절 형용사이므로 비교급은 more dry가 아닌 drier가 올바르다.

② more dry: 원문 drier — dry는 1음절이므로 -er 비교급 사용 → more dry는 부적절 ←정답
③ fewer: 'fewer clouds' — clouds는 가산명사 복수이므로 fewer 적절
④ started: 'people started to live' — 과거시제 동사 적절
det.tip: 1음절 형용사 비교급: -er (cold→colder, dry→drier). 2음절 이상: more + 원급

In Ireland, we often associate the cold with the wet but if it is really cold, there is far less evaporation, fewer clouds, and less rain. Our world in the Ice Age was cold and dry, ①<u>meaning</u> it was difficult for plants to grow. In this type of climate, farming isn't an option: it's too risky to depend on any one piece of land ②<u>producing</u> the energy you need. As the temperature rose and the ice caps melted, we experienced a sudden explosion of life. The world got ③<u>warmer</u> and wetter, and people started to live around places where they could make food grow most intensively. This didn't happen overnight; it probably took thousands of years, with hunter-gatherers ④<u>foraging</u> and hunting, while doing a little side hustle in farming.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② producing → to produce: 'depend on any one piece of land to produce ~'에서 목적을 나타내는 to부정사가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
① meaning: 'cold and dry, meaning it was difficult ~' — 결과/부연의 분사구문 — 적절
② producing: 원문 to produce — 'depend on land to produce'에서 목적의 to부정사 필요 → producing은 부적절 ←정답
③ warmer: 'The world got warmer' — 비교급 형용사 — 적절
④ foraging: 'with hunter-gatherers foraging and hunting' — 분사구문 — 적절
det.tip: depend on A to V: A에 의존하여 ~하다 (목적의 to부정사)

questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 빙하기의 춥고 건조한 기후 조건이 농경을 불가능하게 했고, 기온 상승과 함께 점진적으로 농경 생활로 전환되었다는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
① 아일랜드는 예시일 뿐, 글 전체 주제가 아님
② 수렵채집이 우월하다는 내용 없음
③ 종 다양성 감소가 아닌 '생명의 폭발(explosion of life)' 언급
④ 빙하기 기후(춥고 건조) → 농경 불가 → 기온 상승 → 점진적 농경 전환 ←정답
det.tip: 글의 주제는 빙하기→기후변화→농경 전환의 과정

ch: 아일랜드의 기후 변화와 농업 발전의 역사
